comparison: RLPD prior-data arm versus the matched online-only ten-Q pixel SAC control; not standard two-Q SAC or DrQ algorithm superiority.

evaluation.pilot_gate: both RLPD learner seeds must have an eligible deterministic actor with at least one canonical screen finish; each selected RLPD seed's finish count must be no lower than its matched online-only SAC seed
evaluation.purpose: custom internal screen; confirmation/blind seeds are reserved but not opened by the pilot
evaluation.stop_on_failure: Record failed/ineligible; do not expand this pilot's collection/training/evaluation budget or open confirmation/blind. Any new hypothesis requires its own source/protocol and fresh allocation.

execution.screen: custom evaluate_policy protocol-file, `screen` partition only; use the verified CPU21 interpreter. Do not execute reserved confirmation/blind cells.

execution_scope: internal-local-study-only; no official confirmation, model confirmation, or submission

future_full_reservation.status: reserved_not_opened; requires new full protocol and successful pilot gate

candidate_seed_token_audit.method: Exact standalone uint32 token search in recorded text artifacts; decimal/hash substrings and current talk coordination are excluded.
candidate_seed_token_audit.scope: No known recorded use only; incomplete historical pilot/training schedules preclude a global non-use proof.

geometry_audit.cross_lane_coordination: No RLPD geometry is borrowed from the independent DrQ teacher-replay study. Candidate ranges were posted for collision coordination; the available prior message reported no frozen new cell allocation at audit time.
geometry_audit.freshness_statement: No known recorded use in searchable text artifacts or either original DrQ training ledger. Older pilot and sampled-training schedules are incomplete; this is not a global historical non-use proof. Candidate cells are frozen, not yet consumed.

hypothesis: At matched online student decisions and learner updates, a frozen prior dataset sampled 50:50 with online replay may improve screen completion over the same pixel SAC without offline replay.
limitations: Freshness is no-known-recorded-use under an incomplete historical record, not global proof.
Two student seeds and the small correlated screen are internal descriptive evidence, not broad statistical confirmation.
The online-only control matches the pixel learner, not total environment cost including the prior teacher dataset.
A favorable pilot screen alone is not a model promotion, official result, submission, or authorization to reuse holdouts.
name: pixel-rlpd-offpolicy-pilot-v2

reservation_contract.meaning: cross-track uint32 exclusion list; every pilot/full evaluation geometry and all prior documented reservations are excluded from teacher/student training
reservation_contract.training_sampler: This implementation samples only the explicitly frozen training_geometry_seeds subset.

cpu_evaluation_contract.source: existing local CPU21 runtime, verified at protocol freeze; not modified official environment

source.port: independent PyTorch implementation; only pinned pixel algorithm contracts are ported

student_training.temperature_fidelity_warning: The pinned author loss with entropy=-log_pi and target_entropy=-1.5 has a positive dL/d(log_alpha) for ordinary positive differential entropy, so this port can reduce alpha throughout training. It is retained verbatim for source fidelity; do not describe -1.5 as a positive entropy target.
student_training.training_sampler: independent default_rng(seed+0x5A11) samples uniform track/geometry pairs from the frozen training pool; matched arms share the same indexed stream

teacher.algorithm: DrQ-v2 pad-4 control, original training seed 1
teacher.prior_use: The same actor previously served as a frozen base in DrQ residual-option development; its old trajectory is not imported.
teacher.reuse_scope: frozen action generator only; no original trajectory, screen/confirmation/blind path, critic, replay, optimizer, or checkpoint state is imported

teacher_data_budget.partial_episode: drop without fabricating terminal; count all consumed decisions
teacher_data_budget.source_repeats: one attempt per frozen training geometry cell
